aging-01-c1.text: Carlos López-Otín, Maria A. Blasco, Linda Partridge, Manuel Serrano, Guido Kroemer (2013). The hallmarks of aging. Cell 153(6):1194-1217.
aging-01-c1.quote: This Review enumerates nine tentative hallmarks that represent common denominators of aging in different organisms
aging-01-c1.claim: In 2013, Carlos Lopez-Otin, Maria Blasco, Linda Partridge, Manuel Serrano, and Guido Kroemer published The Hallmarks of Aging in Cell

aging-01-c2.text: Carlos López-Otín, Maria A. Blasco, Linda Partridge, Manuel Serrano, Guido Kroemer (2023). Hallmarks of aging: An expanding universe. Cell 186(2):243-278.
aging-01-c2.quote: We propose the following twelve hallmarks of aging: genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, disabled macroautophagy, deregulated nutrient-sensing, mitochondrial dysfunction, cellular senescence, stem cell exhaustion, altered intercellular communication, chronic inflammation, and dysbiosis.
aging-01-c2.claim: The 2023 revision (Lopez-Otin et al., Cell) added three hallmarks, reflecting a decade of mechanistic and clinical evidence.

aging-02-c2.text: Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet (2009). Scientific background: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2009. NobelPrize.org.
aging-02-c2.quote: The 2009 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded to Drs. Elizabeth H Blackburn, Jack W Szostak and Carol W Greider for their discovery of how chromosomes are protected by telomeres and the enzyme telomerase.
aging-02-c2.claim: The three shared the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

aging-02-c2.text: Bodnar AG, Ouellette M, Frolkis M, Holt SE, Chiu CP, Morin GB, Harley CB, Shay JW, Lichtsteiner S, Wright WE (1998). Extension of life-span by introduction of telomerase into normal human cells. Science (New York, N.Y.).
aging-02-c2.quote: Notably, the telomerase-expressing clones have a normal karyotype and have already exceeded their normal life-span by at least 20 doublings
aging-02-c2.claim: Re-expression of hTERT alone is sufficient to immortalise primary human fibroblasts (Bodnar et al., 1998)

aging-04-c1.text: Kenyon C, Chang J, Gensch E, Rudner A, Tabtiang R (1993). A C. elegans mutant that lives twice as long as wild type. Nature.
aging-04-c1.quote: We have found that mutations in the gene daf-2 can cause fertile, active, adult Caenorhabditis elegans hermaphrodites to live more than twice as long as wild type. This lifespan extension, the largest yet reported in any organism, requires the activity of a second gene, daf-16.
aging-04-c1.claim: Cynthia Kenyon's 1993 paper showed that daf-2 loss-of-function in C. elegans doubles lifespan and requires the FOXO-orthologue daf-16.

aging-03-c3.text: Baker DJ, Wijshake T, Tchkonia T, LeBrasseur NK, Childs BG, van de Sluis B, Kirkland JL, van Deursen JM (2011). Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders. Nature.
aging-03-c3.quote: we made use of a biomarker for senescence, p16(Ink4a), to design a novel transgene, INK-ATTAC
aging-03-c3.claim: Darren Baker, Jan van Deursen and colleagues reported the experiment in a 2011 paper in Nature.

aging-05-c1.text: Horvath S (2013). DNA methylation age of human tissues and cell types. Genome biology.
aging-05-c1.quote: The predictor, which is freely available, was developed using 8,000 samples from 82 Illumina DNA methylation array datasets, encompassing 51 healthy tissues and cell types.
aging-05-c1.claim: Steve Horvath's 2013 paper in Genome Biology was a turning point.

aging-06-c1.text: Takahashi K, Yamanaka S (2006). Induction of pluripotent stem cells from mouse embryonic and adult fibroblast cultures by defined factors.
aging-06-c1.quote: Here, we demonstrate induction of pluripotent stem cells from mouse embryonic or adult fibroblasts by introducing four factors, Oct3/4, Sox2, c-Myc, and Klf4, under ES cell culture conditions.
aging-06-c1.claim: Shinya Yamanaka's 2006 paper showed that four transcription factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc (OSKM)) when introduced into mouse fibroblasts produce induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) functionally equivalent to embryonic stem cells.

aging-06-c2.text: Ocampo A, Reddy P, Martinez-Redondo P, et al (2016). In Vivo Amelioration of Age-Associated Hallmarks by Partial Reprogramming. Cell.
aging-06-c2.quote: partial reprogramming by short-term cyclic expression of Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc (OSKM) ameliorates cellular and physiological hallmarks of aging and prolongs lifespan in a mouse model of premature aging.
aging-06-c2.claim: Alejandro Ocampo, working in Juan Carlos Izpisua Belmonte's lab, published the foundational partial-reprogramming paper in 2016 (Cell).
